# GitHub Copilot Instructions

- Follow Python 3 best practices and PEP 8.
- Keep code modular and reusable.
- Use descriptive variable and function names.
- Add docstrings where appropriate.
- Preserve existing functionality while refactoring.
- Implement Sudoku features incrementally.
- Ensure generated puzzles have exactly one unique solution.
- Use Flask best practices.
- Use pytest for testing.
- Keep HTML, CSS, and JavaScript organized.
- Make the UI responsive and support light/dark mode.
- Explain complex code before generating it when asked.
